findings.fact: No project licence field, root licence file, or rights-holder attestation exists.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Author or rights holder selects the source-code licence and supplies the exact licence file and release metadata.

findings.fact: setuptools>=68 is declared for isolated builds but has no resolved record in uv.lock and no audited build artifact.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Freeze and audit the isolated build-system closure without changing the author licence decision.

findings.fact: requires-python >=3.11 does not define a finite OS, architecture, implementation, libc, and Python support matrix.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Freeze supported targets and evaluate every dependency marker per target.

findings.fact: Legacy License fields and classifiers are preserved but cannot be promoted automatically to SPDX expressions.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Audit exact artefacts and preserve unresolved AND, OR, and component scope as UNKNOWN where metadata is insufficient.

findings.fact: Top-level metadata does not close vendored or bundled component and licence-file scope.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Create per-artifact licence-file and bundled-component records, beginning with pip, NumPy, matplotlib, and fonttools.

findings.fact: Source-code licence and future article OA licence are distinct and both remain unselected.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Keep separate rights-holder and future publisher-workflow evidence; never infer either from the other.

findings.fact: The ignored shared project environment changed interpreter and package population during the audit.
findings.smallestClosureAction: Exclude the shared environment from authoritative inventory evidence and use immutable isolated materialisations.
